title: BetterSuicide
description: Simple /kill and /suicide plugin for modern anarchy servers looking to replace OldSchoolKill
body:
**BetterSuicide** is a simple, lightweight and modern plugin that replaces OldSchoolKill

Fully compatible with Minecraft 1.21.11 and Java 21+

It **DOES NOT** require any permission setup. By default, players have access to /kill and /suicide.
This also prevents players without the appropriate permissions from using /kill to kill other entities

It also provides the popular alternative command "/suicide"
